name: policy-review-copy
prompt: Create a review-ready Remote Work Policy for the People Operations team. Structure it with Purpose, Eligibility, Workspace Support, Security, and Approval sections. Present the proposed monthly home-office stipend as a tracked insertion. Mark an outdated requirement to submit a weekly desk photograph as a tracked deletion. Add a reviewer comment to the stipend amount and reply to that comment with a finance note, leaving the discussion open. Bookmark the Security section as Security_Requirements and add a cross-reference to it from the approval checklist. Include a link to https://example.com/security, one footnote for equipment ownership, and a concise approval checklist. Add a footer with the document title, the current date field, and Page X of Y.
